retainedSelectedDirections.target: Select the native self-transformation, not an unprinted ally transformation. Preserve120ft in the native envelope; any insight use of that reach remains a declared choice, not a free remote information grant.
retainedSelectedDirections.identity: Retain the same actor, memories, class resources and injuries. Transformation must be mechanically useful and must not be replaced by cosmetic glow. No flight, incorporeality, immunity, added HP pool or deity origin follows from energy/avatar wording.
retainedSelectedDirections.lifecycle: Select a finite continuing form route, keeping the Instantaneous/temporary conflict visible. Duration, concentration choice, full form and safe return operation are mandatory unresolved fields; do not silently borrow a lower spell duration.
retainedSelectedDirections.alignment: Use current effective-axis queries, applying existing Lock/Anchor after ordinary underlying history. Undefined/protected axes remain unavailable. Body/insight reactions to later changes and recast require the missing complete profile.
retainedSelectedDirections.insight: Separate useful information operation from body mechanics. Exact facts, observation predicates, timing and protection handling require an approved contract. No future certainty or cosmology inferred.

retainedSharedContracts.access: Rank9, minimumclass17, base26RP, Action,120ft,V/S/F. Actual acquisition, preparation/known list, components and class-source school must be demonstrated. Ascension: Cleric Divination; Druid/Mage/Wizard Conjuration. Other spells preserve their individual native rows. Access does not itself complete a pending operational card.
retainedSharedContracts.payment: For a complete legally authorized cast, verify public preconditions, then commit actual Action and final priced RP with class-specific chronological Dissonance/Refrain and concentration transitions before interruptions. A failed/countered paid cast refunds nothing. Missing operational content is a review gate, not a fictitious gameplay cast.
retainedSharedContracts.privacy: Known illegality differs from hidden facts. Resolve hidden alignment, faction permission/protection and corruption only after legal payment; expose only the promised result. No missing record becomes false, Neutral or zero by convenience. No secret diagnostic list.
retainedSharedContracts.clocks: Ready uses its current paid setup, real Reaction release and next-regular-start expiry. Summon/benefit clocks remain source-relative. Do not treat spell pulses as actor turns, pause deadlines in suppression, create extra turns or bank commands. Incomplete durations prevent complete end-to-end clock certification.
retainedSharedContracts.state: Preserve body identity, HP/injuries, resources, original memories, equipment/custody, alignment axes and imposed overlays, standing/history/permissions, corruption source IDs and parent dependencies, typed knowledge, source rank, exact timestamps, reservations and terminal reasons. Idempotent event IDs prevent replay. Audit inverse operations never authorize an in-world rewind.
retainedSharedContracts.overlap: Resolve an actual source permission within its exact scope. A standing-only predicate can change after maximization; membership/invocation/allied-status predicates remain independent. A protected alignment axis stays protected under its actual accepted rule. No universal priority, faction or soul engine is authored.
